headline: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_S re-run on the rebuilt ryzen3090 box with the RTX 3080 Ti (CUDA b12500) — the 6700 XT row's hardware swapped. Quality holds (all objective tests pass, first fully clean fractal), but the 4-thread CPU is now the limiter: decode ~5-7.5 tok/s, and the 29K context cap that lets the 27B fit on 12 GB truncates delta and rules out the 87K retrieval probe entirely.
facts: Model file identical to both prior rows
Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-IQ2_S-mtp.gguf (9.61 GB, ukisai GSQ-RCO GGUF repo) — byte-identical to the swift-1.5-iq2-s (3080 Ti, LM Studio era) and swift-1.5-iq2-s-rx6700xt rows.

llama.cpp b12500 win-cuda-12.4 llama-server via Windows scheduled task on the rebuilt ryzen3090 (Ryzen 3 2200G 4C/4T, 16 GB DDR4-2133, Windows 11). -ngl 99 -c 29184 -fa on -ctk/-ctv q8_0, kv_unified, PAR 1, spec-type draft-mtp n-max 3.
12,017 / 12,288 MiB — full model + MTP draft + Q8_0 KV at 29K resident on the card; MTP draft context created against the target (log-verified).

speed test recorded 4.06 tok/s but the model early-EOSd at 172 tokens (same short-generation shape as the 6700 XT row's 18.86 at 176 tok — both rows under-report). Server print_timing steady-state during games: ~7.5 tok/s (tg_3s 6.2-7.1).

exact40 = 1.8 (7/40 exact, thinking off); tools16 = 10.0 (16/16 streamed cases clean); retrieval87k = HTTP 400 — the ~87K-token probe exceeds the 29K context cap; a 12 GB card cannot host the config the probe requires.

breakout: loop x3 at 47K chars (gen1), loop x3 at 74K chars (gen2) — no doc. delta: filled 29,090 tok then died mid font-table, zero gameplay. fractal: painted 2/2 canvases, responds (zoom changed HUD coords), 0 JS errors, complete doc.

same model, same tests: objective passes identical; decode slower (5-7.5 vs 17-18.5 tok/s — CUDA+MTP draft chain on a 4-thread CPU costs more than Vulkan did); fractal 4 -> 9, delta 6 -> 3 (context wall hit at a different test), breakout 7 -> 0 (regression vs that row's playable game).

hard tier: tools16 10.0 = 10.0; exact40 1.8 vs 3.5; retrieval probe impossible here (29K vs 100K context). Model families differ (IQ2_S dense 27B vs flash-next MoE iq3_s) so exact40 is not purely a hardware delta.

observations.text: The card is not the constraint on this box: the 3080 Ti holds the whole 27B + KV with 271 MiB to spare. The two hard walls are the 4-thread 2200G (decode 5-7.5 tok/s with MTP drafting) and the 29K context ceiling forced by 12 GB.
fractal quality improved markedly vs the 6700 XT row on identical sampling rules — evidence the CUDA path preserves codegen quality better than Vulkan on this box despite lower throughput.
exact40 and retrieval87k are the first hard-tier data ever recorded for this model.

open: MTP tax unquantified: steady decode with --spec-type none not measured; 6700 XT ran MTP too, so the 7.5 vs 17-18.5 gap is CUDA+CPU+driver, not draft-vs-no-draft.
breakout loop points differ between generations (47K vs 74K) — sampling-dependent, so the 0 stands but a third generation could squeak a doc; deemed not worth ~2 h at 7 tok/s.
speed-test early-EOS at 172 tok makes the speed cell under-reported (same shape as the 6700 XT row) — treat the 7.5 tok/s print_timing anchor as the honest decode number.
